physics_review.units: ismPerM3 = ismNCm3 * 1e6 (cm^-3 -> m^-3, package wants m^-3): correct. brakeHoldsAgainstDrag(mEff, accelSI(boostG * standardGravity()), n_m3, rapidityOfOneMinusBeta(cap), R): boost_g in g -> c/yr via kinematics.standardGravity -> m/s^2 via medium.accelSI: correct. Cruise drag: mirrorDragPower(n_m3, |phi|, R) [W] * dtau [yr] * julianYearS() [s/yr] = J: correct. Boost/brake: photonDriveEnergy(mEff, |phi_after - phi_before|) per tick, telescopes to m_eff c^2 |phi| over a monotone burn and counts the final piece that lands at rest; a swing through zero counts brake + reverse boost, which is physically right.
physics_review.threshold_check: Independently recomputed: drag at the cap (HB-50) 2.36e5 N; photon thrust m_eff * 750000 * 9.80665 m/s^2 -> m_eff_min = 0.0321 kg (V12). Tests pin 0.03/0.032 refused, 0.033 accepted at both the core (checkScenarioMEff) and wire (checkMEffTooSmall) level.
physics_review.closed_mass_budget: availableKg is written once in newWorld (availableKgStart() = 20000) and never touched again; checkMassClosed covers diag boost/cruise/brake/turn/cancel/draw and a non-diag world; evaluator mutation 20001 killed. mass-budget.md Starting Mass: ~20,000 kg total internal mass.
physics_review.precision: gamma, beta and oneMinusBeta come from kinematics (betaOf, gammaOf, oneMinusBeta); no `1.0 - beta` anywhere; rapidityOfOneMinusBeta used for the cap. No trip or bubble formula outside the package (AC18 clean; the only arithmetic in core is unit conversion and |dphi|).
physics_review.determinism: No hidden state: World carries everything; Rng counters zero; tick is pure with requires/ensures contracts; VM == interpreter on strict worldVm and protocolVm.
physics_review.note: A same-tick heading turn at rest snaps |beta| < 1e-9 to 0 before the ledger's `before` motion is read, so up to m_eff c^2 * 1e-9 ~ 9e7 J can be dropped from boostJ per turn. Negligible against boosts of ~1e16 J; note only.

deviations.1_tick_returns_Ticked: ACCEPTED. `tick(world, {dtau, intents}) -> Ticked{world, refused, events}` with protocol.serve building the StateMsg keeps the core free of the codec and avoids a core -> protocol import cycle; change-sets need encodeClock/encodeShip to compare text. Better layering than the plan's `(World, StateMsg)`.
deviations.2_domain_types_moved_to_core: ACCEPTED. Intent/Target/Params/defaultParams/Refusal/Event are domain types; core owns them, protocol imports them; protocol_test import line updated; AC18 still clean.
deviations.3_ledger_not_on_wire: ACCEPTED, with a due date. The M2.2 protocol task list has no ledger section; the design puts the energy readouts in M2.3a. The ledger must be on the wire by M2.3a/b for AC6 checkLedgerAtArrival, and that is also when the surviving m_eff mutations (code_quality) must be killed.
